world.title: Infrastructure that spans nations demands protection that outlasts decades.
world.body: From the Nile Delta to the Arabian Gulf, the pipelines and facilities that power modern civilization face relentless attack. Every joint, every weld, every exposed surface is a front line.

problem.title: Corrosion doesn't announce itself.
problem.body1: It works silently — inside pipelines transporting crude and water, beneath thermal insulation, along buried infrastructure. By the time it's visible, structural compromise has already begun.
problem.body2: The question is never whether corrosion will occur. It is whether your system is engineered to stop it before it stops you.

methodology.title: A three-phase discipline.

story.title: Built on the premise that corrosion is an engineering problem — not an inevitability.
story.p1: United Services Egypt was established in 2005 by a group of petroleum engineers who had spent their careers watching preventable corrosion failures drain resources from major oil & gas operators across the MENA region.
story.p2: Their conviction: that international-standard corrosion-control solutions — GRE lining, FBE coating, RTP systems — were available globally but applied inconsistently in Egypt and the broader region, largely due to a lack of local engineering expertise and certified manufacturing capacity.
story.p3: USE was built to close that gap. Today, from our 6,000 m² integrated manufacturing and application facility in Cairo, we serve EGPC, ADNOC, BP, Shell, and more than fifteen other major operators across Egypt, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.

vision.title: Vision & Mission
vision.visionTitle: To be the MENA region's most trusted corrosion engineering partner.
vision.visionBody: We envision a region where energy infrastructure operates at its engineered design life — where no pipeline fails prematurely because the right corrosion-control system was unavailable, unaffordable, or poorly applied.
vision.missionTitle: Deliver certified corrosion-control solutions with zero compromise on quality.
vision.missionBody: Our mission is to protect the infrastructure that powers the region — by applying rigorous engineering, qualified materials, and certified workmanship to every project, regardless of scale or location.
